scope: Fine-tune a small pretrained English/alphanumeric visual recognizer for room codes only. Course OCR and timetable geometry remain frozen.
dataPolicy: Only supplied screenshot pixels and their manual labels are used for fine-tuning. No new external training images, text generation or room dictionary. Pretrained public weights are permitted.
grouping: Screenshots of related timetables 1/2 and 4/5 stay in train; related 7/8 stay together in test. Exact screenshot duplicates were removed. Exact ROI duplicates are audited across splits and deduplicated within train.
limitations: All eight screenshots were previously inspected and used in baseline parser development. This is a held-out fine-tuning experiment, not a fully unseen product benchmark. Very small validation/test source count.
model: EasyOCR english_g2 VGG-BiLSTM-CTC; pretrained character inventory unchanged
selection: Highest validation exact-code accuracy, then lowest CER, then lowest validation CTC loss; epoch zero eligible. No test-based selection.
primaryMetric: Exact room-code match on all test records with a visible non-empty room code; missing/failed ROI remains incorrect
secondaryMetrics: all-fields timetable accuracy with room-code substitution
comparison: same room-code model after validation-selected fine-tuning
protocolRevision: Before test evaluation: removed two visually audited wrong training crops; added validation loss tie-breaker because validation accuracy/CER were saturated at epoch zero. Initial invalid run archived locally.
